title: Build long-form case studies with the fixed format from existing project data only; do not ask the author for more case-study content
body: Format per project: [Name] · [Role] · [Year]; Problem = 2 sentences about the business, not the technology (`problem`); What I built = 3 bullets (`solution`); Decisions = technical decisions with their why and trade-off (`decisions`, `TechnicalDecision.tradeoff` is mandatory: with no trade-off it was not a decision); Outcome = a number or a qualitative before/after (`outcome`); Stack; Links = live demo + repo if public; Evidence = screenshot, short GIF or 20 s video, never an empty mockup. The decisions block is the differentiator: it is what a technical hiring manager actually reads. JWD Maderas is the main case for freelance clients (a complete product for a real business), not the maps, but it stays hidden until it launches. What is loaded in content/data/content.es.json is all the author has: render from it, never fill a `TODO` in `problem`/`outcome` by eye (invariant 4), and do not prompt the author for more material.
not_derivable: The schema has the fields but not the section order, length limits, which project leads for freelance clients, or that the author has no further material to give.

evidence.summary: tradeoff: z.string().min(1, 'With no trade-off it was not a decision').
Author 2026-10-29: the loaded project data is all there is; JWD Maderas is the main freelance case.
